about: Observed waterlogging reports used to check PRITHVI AI honestly (Replay tab, docs/validation.md). Every entry must link to a real source. Only add reports you can source; never invent entries. Copy to frontend/public/data/observed_waterlogging.json after editing (make validation).

fields.event_date: local date of the flooding, YYYY-MM-DD
fields.lat: latitude (WGS84, decimal degrees) of the reported spot
fields.description: what was reported, e.g. 'knee-deep water on the main road for 3 hours'
fields.source_url: link to the news story or official document
fields.collected_on: date the entry was added, YYYY-MM-DD
fields.event_end_date: optional last local day, for a storm reported over several days
fields.osm_way_ids: optional: OpenStreetMap way ids (as in the pilot dataset) when the report names a whole street or locality road; the check then measures distance to the street, not to the point

reports.description: Deccan Chronicle (29 Jun 2026): Sunday thunderstorm downpour; Main Road listed among low-lying areas affected by waterlogging. No depth given.
reports.location_method: Named street in the pilot's OpenStreetMap data (data/processed/pilot_kakinada_01.json); lat/lon = point on the street nearest its length-weighted midpoint. The report names the street, not a spot on it.
reports.collected_by: Claude (research assistant) - for the team to review
